name: mysql-cluster
description: MySQL InnoDB Group Replication: 3 members, single primary, automatic failover, TLS between members

settings.name: user
settings.description: user with all privileges on that database

components.name: mysql
args:
set -eu
# mysql-cluster replica: InnoDB Group Replication, single primary. Runs as the container command;
# secrets arrive in the environment (env file), never in argv.
me="$ZIRO_REPLICA.$ZIRO_APP.cluster.ziro"
g="$GR_GROUP"
seeds=$(printf %s "$ZIRO_PEERS" | sed 's/\([^,]*\)/\1:3306/g')
(
	umask 077
	printf '[client]\nuser=root\npassword="%s"\n' "$MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD" > /tmp/.root.cnf
	printf '[client]\nuser=ziro_gr\npassword="%s"\nconnect-timeout=3\n' "$GR_PASSWORD" > /tmp/.gr.cnf
)
cat > /docker-entrypoint-initdb.d/ziro-gr.sh <<'SQL'
docker_process_sql --database=mysql <<-EOSQL
	SET SQL_LOG_BIN=0;
	CREATE USER IF NOT EXISTS 'ziro_gr'@'%' IDENTIFIED BY '${GR_PASSWORD}' REQUIRE SSL;
	GRANT REPLICATION SLAVE, CONNECTION_ADMIN, BACKUP_ADMIN, CLONE_ADMIN, GROUP_REPLICATION_STREAM ON *.* TO 'ziro_gr'@'%';
	GRANT SELECT ON performance_schema.* TO 'ziro_gr'@'%';
	SET SQL_LOG_BIN=1;
	-- Initialization is local to each member; the group's history starts empty on all of them.
	RESET BINARY LOGS AND GTIDS;
EOSQL
SQL
q() { mysql --defaults-extra-file=/tmp/.root.cnf -N -B -e "$1" 2>/dev/null; }
# The recovery password goes over stdin, never argv (visible in ps).
start_gr() {
	{
		[ "$1" = bootstrap ] && echo "SET GLOBAL group_replication_bootstrap_group=ON;"
		echo "START GROUP_REPLICATION USER='ziro_gr', PASSWORD='$GR_PASSWORD';"
		[ "$1" = bootstrap ] && echo "SET GLOBAL group_replication_bootstrap_group=OFF;"
		true
	} | mysql --defaults-extra-file=/tmp/.root.cnf
}
(
	until [ "$(q 'SELECT @@skip_networking' || true)" = 0 ]; do sleep 2; done
	while :; do
		state=$(q "SELECT MEMBER_STATE FROM performance_schema.replication_group_members WHERE MEMBER_ID=@@server_uuid" || true)
		if [ "$state" != ONLINE ] && [ "$state" != RECOVERING ]; then
			# Count peers that answer, and whether any of them is in an ONLINE group.
			online=0 answered=0 peers=0
			for p in $(printf %s "$ZIRO_PEERS" | tr , ' '); do
				[ "$p" = "$me" ] && continue
				peers=$((peers + 1))
				if n=$(mysql --defaults-extra-file=/tmp/.gr.cnf -h "$p" -N -B -e "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM performance_schema.replication_group_members WHERE MEMBER_STATE='ONLINE'" 2>/dev/null); then
					answered=$((answered + 1))
					if [ "${n:-0}" -gt 0 ]; then online=1; fi
				fi
			done
			if [ "$online" = 1 ]; then
				echo "[ziro] joining the group"
				start_gr join || true
			elif [ "$ZIRO_REPLICA" = 1 ] && [ "$answered" = "$peers" ]; then
				# Bootstrap only when every peer answers and none is in a group: a partitioned
				# replica 1 never starts a second group (split brain). After a full outage with a
				# member gone for good, bootstrap by hand (docs/apps.md).
				echo "[ziro] all peers up, no group: bootstrapping"
				start_gr bootstrap || true
			fi
		fi
		sleep 5
	done
) &
exec docker-entrypoint.sh mysqld --server-id="$ZIRO_REPLICA" --report-host="$me" \
	--gtid-mode=ON --enforce-gtid-consistency=ON \
	--disabled-storage-engines=MyISAM,BLACKHOLE,FEDERATED,ARCHIVE,MEMORY \
	--plugin-load-add=group_replication.so --plugin-load-add=mysql_clone.so \
	--loose-group-replication-group-name="${g:0:8}-${g:8:4}-${g:12:4}-${g:16:4}-${g:20:12}" \
	--loose-group-replication-start-on-boot=OFF --loose-group-replication-local-address="$me:3306" \
	--loose-group-replication-group-seeds="$seeds" --loose-group-replication-communication-stack=MYSQL \
	--loose-group-replication-ssl-mode=REQUIRED --loose-group-replication-recovery-use-ssl=ON

notes: Writes go to the primary (see the 'primary' query); a failed primary is replaced automatically. Use an odd number of replicas (3, 5, ...).
